jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT PLOY Ploy is building an AI-native growth engine for modern marketing teams — combining high-leverage product experiences with reliable, scalable systems. We’re a small, fast-moving team shipping new product surfaces weekly and hardening them for real production traffic. If you enjoy building end-to-end products, sweating details, and scaling what you ship, you’ll fit in well. THE ROLE As a Founding Engineer, you’ll work across the stack to build core product experiences and the systems behind them. You’ll partner closely with product and design, own projects from idea → shipped → scaled, and help shape the engineering culture and technical direction as we grow. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build 0→1 product features end-to-end: discovery, technical design, implementation, launch, and iteration. - Use the latest AI tools every day — build with them, push their limits, and learn alongside teammates doing the same. - Ship across the stack (web app, backend services, data, infrastructure) with a bias toward simple, durable systems. - Build product experiences with strong UX quality: interaction design, performance, and polish. - Design and operate systems that scale: reliability, observability, capacity planning, cost/performance trade-offs. - Improve our engineering foundations: architecture, tooling, CI, testing, release processes, and on-call hygiene. - Collaborate tightly with founders and teammates, turning ambiguous problems into crisp execution. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR MUST-HAVES - Strong track record building and shipping 0→1 products (startup, new product line, or major greenfield initiative). - Comfortable as a true full-stack engineer (front-end + backend), and willing to go wherever the work is. - Strong product sense: you can reason about user workflows, trade-offs, and “what matters” without needing perfect specs. - Design intuition: you care about craft, and you can implement clean UI with attention to detail. - Systems mindset: you enjoy making software fast, reliable, and maintainable as usage grows. raw.title: Software Engineer
raw.descriptionHtml:
About Ploy

Ploy is building an AI-native growth engine for modern marketing teams — combining high-leverage product experiences with reliable, scalable systems.

We’re a small, fast-moving team shipping new product surfaces weekly and hardening them for real production traffic. If you enjoy building end-to-end products, sweating details, and scaling what you ship, you’ll fit in well.

The role

As a Founding Engineer, you’ll work across the stack to build core product experiences and the systems behind them. You’ll partner closely with product and design, own projects from idea → shipped → scaled, and help shape the engineering culture and technical direction as we grow.

What you’ll do

  • Build 0→1 product features end-to-end: discovery, technical design, implementation, launch, and iteration.

  • Use the latest AI tools every day — build with them, push their limits, and learn alongside teammates doing the same.

  • Ship across the stack (web app, backend services, data, infrastructure) with a bias toward simple, durable systems.

  • Build product experiences with strong UX quality: interaction design, performance, and polish.

  • Design and operate systems that scale: reliability, observability, capacity planning, cost/performance trade-offs.

  • Improve our engineering foundations: architecture, tooling, CI, testing, release processes, and on-call hygiene.

  • Collaborate tightly with founders and teammates, turning ambiguous problems into crisp execution.

What we’re looking for

Must-haves

  • Strong track record building and shipping 0→1 products (startup, new product line, or major greenfield initiative).

  • Comfortable as a true full-stack engineer (front-end + backend), and willing to go wherever the work is.

  • Strong product sense: you can reason about user workflows, trade-offs, and “what matters” without needing perfect specs.

  • Design intuition: you care about craft, and you can implement clean UI with attention to detail.

  • Systems mindset: you enjoy making software fast, reliable, and maintainable as usage grows.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience scaling products and systems through inflection points (10× traffic, new customer segments, new pricing/billing complexity).

  • Experience with AI-powered products (LLMs, agentic systems, evaluation/observability, prompt/tooling pipelines).

  • Prior experience as an early engineer or founder in a high-ownership environment.

  • Experience in the web and marketing space

How we work

  • Small teams, high ownership, fast iteration.

  • Engineers own product: you’ll partner directly with design and founders, and have real agency over what we build and why.

  • Pragmatic engineering: ship quickly, then harden with the right abstractions.

  • We value clear thinking, taste, and accountability over ceremony.

jobs.title: Founding Growth Manager
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION — GROWTH MANAGER ABOUT THE ROLE Ploy is hiring its first Growth Manager to own everything that happens after a deal closes. You'll be the reason customers launch fast, see impact immediately, and become long-term Ploy advocates. This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role at an early-stage startup. You'll be equal parts project manager, onboarding specialist, and marketing practitioner — someone who can sit across from a customer's growth team and immediately earn their trust. WHAT YOU’LL DO Your goal is to shorten the path to value for Ploy customers. To achieve this goal, you'll own account strategy, implementation, onboarding, training and support for Ploy customers. Key responsibilities: - Lead customer onboarding end-to-end: kickoff, requirements, setup, launch, and handoff - Configure and validate the customer’s setup in Ploy: - Design system / brand system setup - Knowledge base setup (structure + initial content hygiene) - Core integrations setup and verification - Initial “ploybooks” configuration and scheduled ploys that match the customer’s goals - Provide Ploy customers with advice and best practices to get the most out of Ploy - Turn customer goals into an implementation plan with clear milestones and owners - Identify blockers early (data, access, content, approvals) and drive resolution - Build repeatable onboarding playbooks and continuously improve the process based on what breaks - Be the voice of the customer to Product/Engineering: patterns, gaps, and high-impact fixes WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Customers launch on time with a working, correct setup (brand system, KB, integrations, initial ploys) - Customers reach “first value” quickly (they can point to a tangible outcome in the first week or two) - Fewer onboarding escalations and less founder/engineering involvement over time - Onboarding becomes more standardized, measurable, and repeatable WHO YOU ARE - A strong operator. You run a tight process, keep multiple stakeholders moving, and don't let things fall through the cracks. - Web-native. You have real web design experience — you understand design systems, brand guidelines, and how good web execution actually works. This isn't something you'll learn on the job; it's the foundation of your credibility with customers. - Technically comfortable. You're not an engineer, but you can troubleshoot integrations, navigate data issues, and figure out product workflows independently. - A great communicator. Crisp docs, clear status updates, confident customer calls. Customers feel like they're in good hands because they are. - High ownership. You don't wait for perfect instructions. You figure it out and ship. - Customer-obsessed: You care about outcomes and you proactively prevent surprises. BACKGROUND WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required: - 2–4 years of experience in a web design, digital marketing, or agency environment — you've built or overseen web properties and understand what makes them work - Strong marketing fundamentals: web design, SEO, CRO, performance marketing/ads, and related growth channels - Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and complex, multi-stakeholder projects Nice to have: - Experience in customer success, onboarding, implementations, or solutions engineering in B2B SaaS - Familiarity with design systems, branding workflows, and/or knowledge base tooling - Experience at an early-stage startup with fast iteration loops WORKING STYLE This is a cross-functional role. You'll work closely with Sales (warm handoff), Product and Engineering (customer feedback loop), and customers directly — both on calls and heads-down inside the product configuring real setups.

raw.title: Founding Growth Manager
raw.descriptionHtml:
Job Description — Growth Manager

About the role

Ploy is hiring its first Growth Manager to own everything that happens after a deal closes. You'll be the reason customers launch fast, see impact immediately, and become long-term Ploy advocates.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role at an early-stage startup. You'll be equal parts project manager, onboarding specialist, and marketing practitioner — someone who can sit across from a customer's growth team and immediately earn their trust.

What you’ll do

Your goal is to shorten the path to value for Ploy customers. To achieve this goal, you'll own account strategy, implementation, onboarding, training and support for Ploy customers.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead customer onboarding end-to-end: kickoff, requirements, setup, launch, and handoff

  • Configure and validate the customer’s setup in Ploy:

    • Design system / brand system setup

    • Knowledge base setup (structure + initial content hygiene)

    • Core integrations setup and verification

    • Initial “ploybooks” configuration and scheduled ploys that match the customer’s goals

  • Provide Ploy customers with advice and best practices to get the most out of Ploy

  • Turn customer goals into an implementation plan with clear milestones and owners

  • Identify blockers early (data, access, content, approvals) and drive resolution

  • Build repeatable onboarding playbooks and continuously improve the process based on what breaks

  • Be the voice of the customer to Product/Engineering: patterns, gaps, and high-impact fixes

What success looks like

  • Customers launch on time with a working, correct setup (brand system, KB, integrations, initial ploys)

  • Customers reach “first value” quickly (they can point to a tangible outcome in the first week or two)

  • Fewer onboarding escalations and less founder/engineering involvement over time

  • Onboarding becomes more standardized, measurable, and repeatable

Who you are

  • A strong operator. You run a tight process, keep multiple stakeholders moving, and don't let things fall through the cracks.

  • Web-native. You have real web design experience — you understand design systems, brand guidelines, and how good web execution actually works. This isn't something you'll learn on the job; it's the foundation of your credibility with customers.

  • Technically comfortable. You're not an engineer, but you can troubleshoot integrations, navigate data issues, and figure out product workflows independently.

  • A great communicator. Crisp docs, clear status updates, confident customer calls. Customers feel like they're in good hands because they are.

  • High ownership. You don't wait for perfect instructions. You figure it out and ship.

  • Customer-obsessed: You care about outcomes and you proactively prevent surprises.

Background we're looking for

Required:

  • 2–4 years of experience in a web design, digital marketing, or agency environment — you've built or overseen web properties and understand what makes them work

  • Strong marketing fundamentals: web design, SEO, CRO, performance marketing/ads, and related growth channels

  • Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and complex, multi-stakeholder projects

Nice to have:

  • Experience in customer success, onboarding, implementations, or solutions engineering in B2B SaaS

  • Familiarity with design systems, branding workflows, and/or knowledge base tooling

  • Experience at an early-stage startup with fast iteration loops

Working style

This is a cross-functional role. You'll work closely with Sales (warm handoff), Product and Engineering (customer feedback loop), and customers directly — both on calls and heads-down inside the product configuring real setups.

jobs.title: Founding Community Lead
jobs.description: This role is full-time, in-person, in NYC. WHO WE ARE At Ploy, we’re building the first growth automation software with your website at its core. We serve innovative operators at growth and marketing agencies, tech start-ups, and some traditional industries as well. They build their website with Ploy’s agents, and then those agents automatically research the landscape and business context, identify winning strategies for account based personalization, SEO/AEO, conversion rate optimization, and ship dozens of on-brand, on-strategy web pages in seconds to drive traffic and conversions. Our vision is to completely re-define the concept of a marketing website in today’s agentic world. And tear-down the broken, archaic low-code tech stacks of the last generation of website builders. With agents, we can unburden a world of story-tellers from manual work, long timelines, and being blocked by internal and external resourcing, and return them to a world of, “yes, and” + “let’s just do it”. It’s a big, scary ambitious vision, but our team is uniquely positioned to do it. Some of the best design engineers and growth engineers in the world. World-class investors. And one of our co-founders is Bryant Chou, the former co-founder and CTO of Webflow. (Yes, uniquely positioned) And last but not least, hopefully you, the one reading this 😄 ABOUT THE ROLE From our experience at Webflow and other category-defining companies, we believe deeply in the power of community and want to invest in this channel from day 1 to cultivate growth, engagement, and connection. Ploy is hiring its first Community Lead to own everything that this involves. You'll be the reason our users go from lurkers to power users, and from power users to believers. This role sits at the intersection of growth and community. That means converting free and low-usage accounts into high-usage ones through education, activation, and genuine connection. And it means turning our most engaged users, creators, and partners into evangelists who pull others into the ecosystem. Agencies get special focus here. Each one is a force multiplier with its own roster of clients and its own audience, so a big part of this role is turning them into partners who run their own events and create their own content under the Ploy umbrella. You'll be the connective tissue between Ploy's product, vision, and the marketers and agencies who are redefining what it means to build for the web. This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role at an early-stage startup. You'll be building from zero: the programs, the platforms, the rituals, and the culture. That means you'll have real influence over how one of the most exciting categories in AI-powered growth takes shape — not just inside Ploy, but across the broader ecosystem of AI-pilled GTM operators who are hungry for a place to learn, share, and grow together. What you'll own: - Community platform & presence — Launch and run Ploy's community hub, creating a space where growth managers, in-house operators, and agency builders want to spend time - Agency partner programs — Build Ploy's agency program from zero: recruit and onboard partner agencies, then equip them to become force multipliers. Give them the playbooks, co-branded assets, and support to run their own events — workshops, client sessions, local meetups — and create their own content — case studies, tutorials, social — that grows their business and the Ploy ecosystem at the same time - Education & enablement — Develop content, playbooks, webinars, and tutorials that help our ICP get more out of Ploy and stay ahead of the curve on agentic GTM strategy - Member growth & engagement — Design and run programs that drive community growth, deepen retention, and turn power users into advocates - Events & activation — Organize both digital and in-person moments that bring the community to life — AMAs, roundtables, launch events, and more - Cross-functional partnership — Work closely with product, marketing, and sales to surface community insights, close feedback loops, and amplify launches The ideal candidate has: - 2 - 4 years experience leading community efforts at fast-growth B2B - Bonus points for experience building partner, agency, or ambassador programs — you know how to turn a partner into a self-sustaining engine of events and content - Hands-on experience in managing online community programs, including stellar written and verbal communication skills to build positive relationships 1:1 and at scale - Strong understanding of what motivates and engages online communities, and the ability to systemize and operationalize those levers - A genuine pulse on the modern GTM and growth marketing landscape — you know who the AI-pilled operators are, you follow the conversations, and you might already be one of them - An educator's mindset — you love breaking down complex ideas and making people feel capable and excited - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building — this is a zero-to-one role

raw.title: Founding Community Lead
raw.descriptionHtml:
This role is full-time, in-person, in NYC.

Who We Are

At Ploy, we’re building the first growth automation software with your website at its core. We serve innovative operators at growth and marketing agencies, tech start-ups, and some traditional industries as well.

They build their website with Ploy’s agents, and then those agents automatically research the landscape and business context, identify winning strategies for account based personalization, SEO/AEO, conversion rate optimization, and ship dozens of on-brand, on-strategy web pages in seconds to drive traffic and conversions.

Our vision is to completely re-define the concept of a marketing website in today’s agentic world.

And tear-down the broken, archaic low-code tech stacks of the last generation of website builders. With agents, we can unburden a world of story-tellers from manual work, long timelines, and being blocked by internal and external resourcing, and return them to a world of, “yes, and” + “let’s just do it”.

It’s a big, scary ambitious vision, but our team is uniquely positioned to do it.

Some of the best design engineers and growth engineers in the world.

World-class investors.

And one of our co-founders is Bryant Chou, the former co-founder and CTO of Webflow. (Yes, uniquely positioned)

And last but not least, hopefully you, the one reading this 😄

About The Role

From our experience at Webflow and other category-defining companies, we believe deeply in the power of community and want to invest in this channel from day 1 to cultivate growth, engagement, and connection.

Ploy is hiring its first Community Lead to own everything that this involves. You'll be the reason our users go from lurkers to power users, and from power users to believers.

This role sits at the intersection of growth and community. That means converting free and low-usage accounts into high-usage ones through education, activation, and genuine connection. And it means turning our most engaged users, creators, and partners into evangelists who pull others into the ecosystem.

Agencies get special focus here. Each one is a force multiplier with its own roster of clients and its own audience, so a big part of this role is turning them into partners who run their own events and create their own content under the Ploy umbrella.

You'll be the connective tissue between Ploy's product, vision, and the marketers and agencies who are redefining what it means to build for the web.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role at an early-stage startup. You'll be building from zero: the programs, the platforms, the rituals, and the culture. That means you'll have real influence over how one of the most exciting categories in AI-powered growth takes shape — not just inside Ploy, but across the broader ecosystem of AI-pilled GTM operators who are hungry for a place to learn, share, and grow together.

What you'll own:

  • Community platform & presence — Launch and run Ploy's community hub, creating a space where growth managers, in-house operators, and agency builders want to spend time

  • Agency partner programs — Build Ploy's agency program from zero: recruit and onboard partner agencies, then equip them to become force multipliers. Give them the playbooks, co-branded assets, and support to run their own events — workshops, client sessions, local meetups — and create their own content — case studies, tutorials, social — that grows their business and the Ploy ecosystem at the same time

  • Education & enablement — Develop content, playbooks, webinars, and tutorials that help our ICP get more out of Ploy and stay ahead of the curve on agentic GTM strategy

  • Member growth & engagement — Design and run programs that drive community growth, deepen retention, and turn power users into advocates

  • Events & activation — Organize both digital and in-person moments that bring the community to life — AMAs, roundtables, launch events, and more

  • Cross-functional partnership — Work closely with product, marketing, and sales to surface community insights, close feedback loops, and amplify launches

The ideal candidate has:

  • 2 - 4 years experience leading community efforts at fast-growth B2B

  • Bonus points for experience building partner, agency, or ambassador programs — you know how to turn a partner into a self-sustaining engine of events and content

  • Hands-on experience in managing online community programs, including stellar written and verbal communication skills to build positive relationships 1:1 and at scale

  • Strong understanding of what motivates and engages online communities, and the ability to systemize and operationalize those levers

  • A genuine pulse on the modern GTM and growth marketing landscape — you know who the AI-pilled operators are, you follow the conversations, and you might already be one of them

  • An educator's mindset — you love breaking down complex ideas and making people feel capable and excited

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building — this is a zero-to-one role
